inputs.text:
Hey, listen to this. We are totally being played with this whole West Asia conflict thing, and if you believe the official story, you're walking right into their trap. It's all a staged distraction set up by the puppet masters behind the curtain to keep everyone compliant.

Just look at how they bring out former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein to spin the narrative, saying a political resolution is vital for success. That's just coded language for the next phase of their coordinated manipulation! When he emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs and calls it an ongoing operation, he is actually exposing the exact timeline of their hidden agenda. They are openly admitting it's an ongoing operation because the elites never intend for it to end; they need this perpetual theater to distract us from their true coordination at the top. Don't believe a single word of what they're feeding you.
